problem:
Given that $x,y\in {C}^{3},$ compute the standard Hermitian inner product $⟨x,y⟩$ of the following two vectors.

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}i \\ i \\ i\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}i \\ 2 \\ -i\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
Using the definition of the standard Hermitian inner product, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y⟩ & ={x}_{1}\overset{―}{{y}_{1}}+{x}_{2}\overset{―}{{y}_{2}}+{x}_{3}\overset{―}{{y}_{3}} \\  & =i\cdot \overset{―}{\,i}+i\cdot \overset{―}{2}+i\cdot (\overset{―}{-\text{i}}) \\  & =i\cdot (-i)+i\cdot 2+i\cdot \text{i} \\  & =1+2i+(-1) \\  & =2i.\end{aligned}
$$
